about: The prep, cook and total time a site writes as a phrase instead of ISO 8601 ('1 hour 30 minutes', '1 hr, 5 mins'), read whole-string only. hours and minutes: case-insensitive regex fragments, tried in order (longest first). joiners: regex fragments that may stand between the hours and the minutes ('and'). hourSymbol and minuteSymbol: how the app writes a time back ('1h 30m'), for ISO times too.
